title: reopen leaves the run state of an item that had landed at landed, so land refuses every step and runs --reconcile does not repair it
goal: reopen of a done item moves its coord run state from landed to none, and runs --reconcile moves a landed run state whose item file is not done to none, so land's first step takes a reopened item to landing

run:
import glob, json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(d, "coord.sqlite"))
    def bl(*a):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/backlog.py", "--root", d, *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
    def coord(*a):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/coord.py", *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
    def state(iid):
        return json.loads(coord("get", "run/" + iid).stdout).get("value")
    def plant(iid):
        rev = (json.loads(coord("get", "run/" + iid).stdout) or {}).get("revision", 0)
        put = coord("put", "run/" + iid, "--value=landed", "--revision", str(rev))
        assert put.returncode == 0, ("coord put", put.stderr[-200:])
    iid = bl("new", "story", "--title", "T", "--goal", "g").stdout.split()[2]
    path = glob.glob(os.path.join(d, "**", iid + ".json"), recursive=True)[0]
    item = json.load(open(path))
    item["status"] = "done"
    item["evidence"] = {"commit": "0" * 40, "checks": []}
    json.dump(item, open(path, "w"))
    plant(iid)
    reopened = bl("reopen", iid, "--why", "planted")
    assert reopened.returncode == 0, ("reopen", (reopened.stdout + reopened.stderr)[-300:])
    assert state(iid) != "landed", ("reopen left the run state at", state(iid))
    plant(iid)
    reconciled = bl("runs", iid, "--reconcile")
    assert reconciled.returncode == 0, ("runs --reconcile", (reconciled.stdout + reconciled.stderr)[-300:])
    assert state(iid) != "landed", ("runs --reconcile left the run state of an item that is not done at", state(iid))

notes: Retro finding of the drain: after reopen of an item that had landed its coord run state stays landed, so land printed 'run/ID is landed, which does not move to landing' at every step, and runs --reconcile did not repair it. Premise (reproduces: the repro): bl_items.cmd_reopen clears evidence, claim and operator and leaves the run key, and bl_runs.drift_of reads a done item whose state is not landed, but never a landed state of an item whose file is not done, since landed is in SETTLED. The new state is none (bl_runs.NONE), the value an item with no run has. BG-mwqxiqqx also edits bl_items.py (cmd_reopen gains --commit): land one after the other.
